title: Diegetic Ring HUD and Wrist Menu (Mission, Constructs, Settings, Log)
description:
Purpose: Implement diegetic ring HUD (charge arc, mastery pips, health chevron on damage) and wrist menu panels opened with X (Left). Panels: Mission (objectives, sector map), Constructs (unlocks, loadout), Settings (locomotion, comfort), Log (tutorial tips).

Behaviour:
- HUD: Head/wrist-anchored minimal elements. Ring-charge bar arcs around right hand; mastery pips below; reticle only while aiming ranged constructs. Health chevron appears briefly under damage.
- Wrist Menu: On X (Left) press, toggle curved panels near left wrist. Navigation via pointing/hover (dominant hand ray) and trigger to select. Close on X again or B.
- Mission panel: Pulls current objectives from mission_flow_system; allows tracking toggle.
- Constructs panel: Shows categories/unlock state (construct_icons_radial), tooltips, and quick equip.
- Settings: Surfaces locomotion settings via locomotion_settings_menu (mode, snap vs smooth turn, vignette, horizon lock). Applies immediately and persists.
- Log: Tutorial tips and mentor guidance toggles.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("open_menu_button", "X_left")
- params.value("close_menu_buttons", ["X_left", "B_right"]) 

Components read/write:
- Uses builtin.hud_anchor internally for panel placement (follow_head false for wrist, true for some HUD elements); reads CRingEnergy and CMasteryProfile; reads/writes CLocomotionSettings through locomotion_settings_menu APIs; reads CMissionState.

Comfort/safety:
- Panels fade and auto-hide during high-intensity combat if desired; never occlude center of view heavily.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_locomotion_menu: Switching modes and turn toggles here applies immediately.
- test_hud_readability: HUD elements legible and minimal.

Assets/scenes: global; assets: ring_ui_hud_assets, ui_wrist_menu_panels, construct_icons_radial, mission_console_hologram, star_map_prop.
